concerns: The cited Indonesian article shows photographic use but does not directly show video recording. One article per locale cannot establish usage frequency or nationwide distribution.
result.rationale: No material counterexample to the proposed shared sense was found. The Malaysian dictionary lists kamera as a photographic device and recognizes kamera video; Indonesian educational material also uses kamera for video recording. The narrower evidence limits the frequency claims, but does not undermine the same-term relation. Sources: https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kamera ; https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/8761/1/Mekanisme%20Pertanian%204-C2%20Simulasi%20Digital%20X-2.pdf
